name: osca/senior-citizen-system
description: OSCA Senior Citizen Profiling and QoL Analytics System

ignore.CVE-2026-48019: No patch for Laravel 11; mitigated by using email:filter rule. Upgrade to Laravel 12.60+ planned.
ignore.PKSA-3r5d-mb8f-1qw9: Same CRLF-in-default-email-rule issue as CVE-2026-48019 (no-CVE advisory record). No Laravel 11 patch (fixed in 12.60); mitigated via email:filter rule. Upgrade to Laravel 12.61+ planned.
ignore.PKSA-m5cs-t1y6-qpcs: Temporary signed URL path confusion. No Laravel 11 patch (fixed in 12.61.1); app generates/validates no temporary signed URLs, so no exposed surface. Upgrade to Laravel 12.61+ planned.
ignore.CVE-2026-59943: Dompdf SVG file/dir existence oracle. Fixed only in dompdf 3.1.6 (major bump from installed 2.0.8, needs its own upgrade + PDF regression pass). The app's only PDF view (seniors.pdf) renders internal, auto-escaped Blade data with no SVG, , or raw HTML — no exposed surface. Major-version dompdf upgrade planned separately.
ignore.CVE-2026-59942: Dompdf DoS via oversized image bitmaps. Same fixed-in-3.1.6-only situation as CVE-2026-59943; app's PDF view embeds no images, so no exposed surface.
ignore.CVE-2026-59941: Dompdf uncontrolled resource consumption via BMP dimensions. Same fixed-in-3.1.6-only situation as CVE-2026-59943; app's PDF view embeds no images, so no exposed surface.
ignore.CVE-2026-56722: Dompdf local file read via SVG data-URI. Same fixed-in-3.1.6-only situation as CVE-2026-59943; app's PDF view has no SVG content, so no exposed surface.
ignore.CVE-2026-55555: Dompdf file existence oracle via font-face stylesheet. Same fixed-in-3.1.6-only situation as CVE-2026-59943; app's PDF view declares no font-face rules, so no exposed surface.
ignore.CVE-2026-55554: Dompdf chroot validation bypass. Same fixed-in-3.1.6-only situation as CVE-2026-59943; app's PDF view has no user-influenced file paths, so no exposed surface.
